description: Verify that the Second Reserved field of the IPv4 Endpoint Option is 0x00 (SOME/IP-SD §5.1.2)
approach:
[Objective]
Wire-format invariant for the IPv4 Endpoint Option: Second Reserved == 0x00.

[Scenario — chronological]
DUT emits a qualifying SD message containing the option (typically an OfferService).
Observation: option's Second Reserved field == 0x00.   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Second Reserved on the wire equals 0x00.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_reserved2 — IPv4 endpoint second reserved nonzero
• Fail_timeout — no qualifying SD message within listen window

verdicts.Pass: IPv4 Endpoint Option Second Reserved = 0x00 — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying SD message within listen window
